paite: TOUPA, na puanin ah kua ahong zintung dia? Na mual siangthou ah kua hong om ding?
heading: Pathian Thiltup David La

paite: Diktak a om, kizentak a hih a, alungtang a thutak genmi pen.
Alei a mi gense ngei lou a, alawm tung a thil hihkhial ngei lou a, a-invengte min leng gense ngeiloumi pen.
Migilou muhsit in a-om nak hi; TOUPA laudan siamte apahtawi hi. Amah a ding a poi ding nangawn kichiam khin a hihlamdang ngei lou mi.
Apung delh ding a asum leitawisak loumi, asiam zaw siam lou tangsak ding a golhna leng la ngeiloumi pen. Huchibang thilhihmi, Bangchik mah in aling kei ding hi.
